name: masscan
title: masscan
description: masscan — internet-scale TCP/UDP port scanner that can sweep the entire IPv4 space in minutes at rates above 1M pps. Set MASSCAN_TARGET (single IP, CIDR, or range list), MASSCAN_PORTS (e.g. '22,80,443,8000-8100' or 'U:53,T:1-65535'), and MASSCAN_RATE (packets/sec, default 1000 — bump to 10000+ on a fast link). Use MASSCAN_EXCLUDE to skip sensitive networks. Run from the DigitalOcean droplet; outbound mass port scanning is prohibited from AWS.
